decisions.proposed_text: Các bảng sau có cùng phần thưởng
decisions.reason: The compact wording preserves that later boards share identical reward contents without the redundant 'nội dung ... giống nhau' construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Uma sở hữu có Thưởng sự kiện
decisions.reason: Compact canonical 'Uma' and a direct owned-item construction preserve that this list contains owned Uma with the event bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Thẻ sở hữu có Thưởng sự kiện
decisions.reason: The event-bonus list context allows the support-card micro form 'Thẻ'; the shorter header keeps the owned-card meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Tổng Thưởng sự kiện <color=#ff911c>tăng tới {0}%</color>
decisions.reason: The compact cap phrasing preserves the cumulative event-bonus maximum increase, placeholder, and color tag exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma có Thưởng sự kiện
decisions.reason: Compact canonical 'Uma' substantially narrows the absence message while preserving the event-bonus category.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma tập có Thưởng sự kiện
decisions.reason: The cramped event UI permits compact 'Uma' and 'tập'; the wording retains the distinction that no training Uma has the event bonus.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có thẻ có Thưởng sự kiện
decisions.reason: The support-card context allows the micro form 'thẻ', preserving the absence of event-bonus cards with much less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Thẻ nhận từ nhiệm vụ
decisions.reason: The compact support-card form is sufficient in this constrained list label and keeps the mission-acquisition meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Mở khóa bằng Dấu trang hồi ức
decisions.reason: The status/list context makes the generic 'Tình trạng' wrapper redundant; the shorter header keeps the bookmark-based unlock category explicit.

decisions.proposed_text: Mở khóa truyện sự kiện
decisions.reason: The list itself supplies status context, so the concise header preserves the event-story unlock category without the wide wrapper.

decisions.proposed_text: Trạng thái nhận thẻ thưởng
decisions.reason: Using compact 'thẻ' removes the untranslated Support Card wording and retains that this section tracks reward-card acquisition status.

decisions.proposed_text: Không dùng được Dấu trang hồi ức
decisions.reason: The current story is already evident from the screen, so removing the repeated object preserves the bookmark restriction and greatly reduces width.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có sự kiện truyện phù hợp
decisions.reason: The filtered-list context makes the explicit condition noun redundant; the compact empty-state still means no story event matches.

decisions.proposed_text: Đã mở bằng Dấu trang hồi ức
decisions.reason: The shorter completion status preserves that the story was unlocked using a Memory Bookmark.

decisions.proposed_text: Đến khi đạt 8 hàng BINGO
decisions.reason: The concise threshold label preserves the condition of reaching eight BINGO lines without the verbose completion construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Quay liên tục tối đa 10 lần
decisions.reason: The roulette screen makes the repeated 'vòng quay' noun unnecessary; the compact instruction keeps the ten-spin consecutive maximum.

decisions.proposed_text:
Đua Đặc biệt <color=#FF911C>không tốn Vé Đua Ký kết</color>
và <color=#FF911C>không phát sinh thời gian ký kết</color>
decisions.reason: The two source lines and both color tags are preserved; the first line removes redundant entry/ticket wording while retaining the Contract Race ticket and no-contract-time effects.

decisions.proposed_text: Còn <color=#FF911C>{0}</color> trận tới Đua Đặc biệt
decisions.reason: The compact countdown preserves the battle-count placeholder, color tag, and distance to the Special Race without the verbose occurrence phrase.

decisions.proposed_text: Số đăng ký
decisions.reason: The roster screen supplies what is being registered, so the counter can use the compact two-word label without losing its operational meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Nhận thưởng thắng tích lũy
decisions.reason: The compact action preserves receiving the cumulative-win reward while removing the verbose full count phrase.
